title: exp
description: Manifest for one experiment: what was parsed, from where, under which method, and — critically — what is MISSING from the compute axis. One per results/index/exps/<exp_id>/ directory.

exp_id.description: directory name under exps/; stable across re-parse of the same span

source_root.description: cluster path the raw artifacts were read from (unmounted elsewhere — keep it so the parse can be repeated)

rollouts.description: rows with kind='rollout' only, not all rows of rollouts.jsonl

cost_complete.description: false if ANY compute consumer of this experiment is unattributed; plots must mark or exclude such experiments on a cost axis

unattributed.description: human-readable list of compute this extract could not account for, e.g. 'proposer tokens (never metered)', 'vLLM serving GPU-time (Slurm records only)', 'GRPO/LoRA update'

parsed_at.description: ISO date the extract was produced

format_version.description: index format version this extract conforms to (currently 1)

source_commit.description: repo commit the experiment ran at, if known

open_questions.description: things the parse could not determine and the user has not yet answered; a non-empty list means this experiment is NOT publication-ready
